test.command: cargo llvm-cov nextest -p printobserver --features test-fixtures --no-report --no-tests=pass -E 'not binary(integration)'

metadata.description: llmlint: ignore[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] Repository policy explicitly requires this OctoPrint tier on every change on both supported platforms, outside the fast gate. Moving its affected edge would not narrow that required schedule; changing the schedule or adding a CI job is outside this dispatch.

llmlint: ignore[changed_behavior_has_e2e] Proving regeneration from a missing or corrupted committed manifest requires the tree surgery this dispatch forbids. The existing reference test compares the committed manifest with the actual runtime surface this write-mode target serializes.
